summary.intent: Win the Lio 'Keep the Line Running' hackathon challenge by analysing Soony's confidential launch data, then building a general recheck-and-act agent product ('Lighthouse') with a polished UI, demo and office-hours preparation before the Sunday 12:00 hand-in.
summary.outcome: Found that the Collector's Edition misses launch despite the 'all ok' plan (overbooked art book receipt, failed statue lot, game card shortfall, sleeve revision conflict), documented it in docs/pages, and built a poller/agent/approval product with Routines and 'How we got here' flow views on main. Most UI work is committed but main was still unpushed (about 14 commits ahead) minutes before the hand-in, and live was not restarted.

repo: Confidential portal data lives in gitignored data/ (raw, drops, notes, img); .env holds SOONY_PORTAL_TOKEN and is gitignored while .env.example is committed.

Portal API has only GET /api/v1/files, /files/{path} and /archive.zip. There are no webhooks, so the right approach is polling and comparing SHA-256 checksums, since files are replaced under the same name and formats can change.
Team workflow files CLAUDE.md and PROGRESS.md exist in the repo; claim work in PROGRESS.md.

Routine steps like 'Chase once if no answer' and 'Ask for a status' are only valid for certain routine watch kinds (waiting messages, shipments); the server rejects them with 'step N cannot be done on open decisions'.
The API server does not load .env on import, so new settings such as ASK_VIEWER_TITLE need a helper that loads .env first.
Routines LLM calls use claude-opus-5-5 with the key from .env, independent of ASK_LLM_PROVIDER.
FlowGraph.tsx exports the routine diagram's connector and node box, which CaseFlow now reuses so the two stay visually consistent.

Branch new-approach (Lucas) contains a Pulse console with its own server, inbox and email sending that bypasses the duplicate-send guard and record-only demo mode; only its 'read documents before verification' step is worth porting.
Demo runs record-only for email; test servers should run on a copy of demo state with the background loop off.

code.finding: New 'How we got here' component: a single top-to-bottom column, built only from the case's own data (agent steps, evidence, prediction, approval rule, options). It omits steps the data lacks and folds on phones. Portal and Reader nodes have an Open link to the evidence drawer.
Describe-it chat for Routines (POST /api/routines/describe). It duplicated the existing 'change in your words' box and was merged then reverted; it stays parked on branch jonas/pulse-ui.

friction: Token was initially empty, so the data work was blocked until the user pasted it.
Entire hooks looked inactive because no checkpoint is written until repo files change.
Misread the team's interest in Pulse and built and merged a duplicate chat UI, then had to undo the merge.
The two-column snake flow was confusing and the connector and box styles did not match the routine diagram, needing two redo passes.
Chase-once and status steps looked broken because the menu offered them on routines where they are invalid.
Phone layout problems: empty gaps, bottom action bar overlapping options, and a crowded top bar.
The sign-in role title 'Senior Buyer' does not exist in the data, so it had to become a setting.
Time pressure: many changes were made in the last 20 minutes before the hand-in, with main unpushed.
open_items: Push main (about 14 commits ahead of origin) before the 12:00 hand-in and restart live so the sign-in choice, 'Waiting for your OK' and heartbeat appear.
Port Lucas's 'read new documents before verification' step into runner.run_pipeline with safeguards (skip without a model, keep try/except); test on a state copy.
Routines page redesign: compact list rows with a MiniFlow, a ⋯ menu for Run/Delete/Code, and duplicate-routine detection.
Support 'send the email, then chase once if no answer' on decision routines via a follow-up watcher.
Pick a Lighthouse logo variant (assistant favours 3, subagent favours 2) and apply it to the favicon, top bar and sign-in.
Optionally make 'All cases' a bottom sheet on phones, opened from the '13 decisions' top-bar link.
Register sender email addresses in the portal Settings so the agent can email Karton Nowak and Boise; the Nowak offer was valid for 24 hours.
Update or delete the earlier Claude doc, and keep the briefing page in sync with the 14:37 drop.
Codex hooks still need approval in /hooks.
The portal login password was pasted into Discord and may need changing after the hack.
